title: The Product sin x cos x Is Odd
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether g(x)=sin x cos x is even, odd, or neither.

steps.title: Negate the Input
steps.explanation: Substitute -x into both factors of the product.
steps.why: Products inherit symmetry through the symmetry of each factor.

steps.title: Apply the Basic Trig Parities
steps.explanation: Sine is odd and cosine is even, so exactly one minus sign appears.
steps.why: sin(-x) = -sin x while cos(-x) = cos x for all x.

steps.title: Conclude
steps.explanation: The product flips sign under negation of the input, so g is odd; equivalently g(x)=(sin 2x)/2, an odd function.
steps.why: An odd function's graph is symmetric under a half-turn about the origin.
